# Falcon Station Operations Handbook

## Water supply

Drinking water comes from the Glassbrook spring, filtered at the pump house.

## Pump house

The pump house filters run on a weekly schedule. Log pressure readings every morning.

## Nesting

Pairs return to the same ledge each spring.
